Pinned commit: 6690b788432fd0f59b0f38e228494bcd6bede1ca
The proxy/ and utils/ files are copied unchanged from this commit.
Desktop tray code is not used. The host adds lifecycle/control, per-socket routing,
protected settings, redacted logs and GUI. Hostname verification stays enabled,
including for the upstream optional fronting context. The shipped CF pool is
pinned; no automatic fetching of the domain list is started by the host.
